hypothesis: The observed analyst's narrow Docker progress filter reduces total Codex tokens for interpreting the retained pull result without losing required facts.
scope: A diagnostic replay, not a fresh image pull or full coding task. One historical success log and two explicitly synthetic failure variants of that log.

cases.append: Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required for registry.example.test/private
Operator diagnostic: Downloading is blocked by disk quota; do not start stack until disk quota is fixed.

quality_gate: Every run reports exit code, all six image digests, incomplete source log, expected action and required diagnostic. Exact automated checks are frozen before invocation. Both arms must pass every case.
acceptance: At least 10% lower pooled native total model tokens and all quality checks pass. Report every pair and every failure. Timing descriptive only. No statistical generalization.
accounting: Deduplicate native response IDs. Include all model input/output and fallback retrievals. Cached input is a subset, not extra. Record wall time, tool response bytes, compaction CPU time and raw hashes. Account for analyst/evaluation overhead separately; actual USD unknown.
execution: Fresh Codex session per cell, same prompt/tools/model/settings; sequential alternating order. One attempt per cell, no retries. Fixed recorded input; full raw retrieval available in both arms. Stop on ambiguous invocation. Captured model request/response pairs retained.
rollback: Do not enable filtering on any quality regression, missing original log, unknown format loss, or failure to meet the token gate. Keep the original logs.
